amr_database_evidence.note: No acquired resistance genes detected by ResFinder. Used as fully susceptible control.

ResFinder.run_cmd: python -m resfinder -ifa data/contigs.fa -o actual/resfinder -j actual/resfinder/resfinder.json -s 'Campylobacter jejuni' -acq

AMRFinderPlus.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/amrfinderplus && amrfinder --nucleotide data/contigs.fa --organism Campylobacter --output actual/amrfinderplus/amrfinder.tsv --plus

CARD_RGI.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/card_rgi && rgi main --input_sequence data/contigs.fa --output_file actual/card_rgi/rgi --input_type contig --clean

abricate.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/abricate && abricate --db resfinder data/contigs.fa > actual/abricate/abricate_resfinder.tsv && abricate --db card data/contigs.fa > actual/abricate/abricate_card.tsv

validation_instructions.resfinder: No resistance genes expected. PASS if all phenotypes show amr_resistant=false in resfinder.json and seq_regions is empty. FAIL if any drug flagged as resistant.
validation_instructions.amrfinderplus: No AMR hits expected. PASS if output TSV contains only the header line. FAIL if any gene row present.
validation_instructions.card_rgi: No high-confidence CARD hits expected (identity >= 95%, bitscore strict). PARTIAL if sub-threshold hits present. FAIL if any Perfect or Strict hits found.
validation_instructions.abricate: No hits expected at default thresholds (min-id 80, min-cov 80). PASS if TSV contains only the header line. FAIL if any gene row present.

notes: Campylobacter jejuni NCTC11351 type strain. Fully susceptible reference. Use for specificity testing — any resistance call is a false positive.
